description: An oil-style night scene of uniformed men raising or lowering a red flag with a white elephant on a tall pole, while a tricolour flag (red, white, blue, white, red) flies from a second pole. A man in a dark dress uniform with a sash and sword gestures on the right, beside men in white formal dress. Gilded, tiered temple roofs and a spire stand behind, with parasols and onlookers on the left. There are no visible letters, no frame, and no blood. The painting runs edge to edge.
